summary: Implementation plan for ZAMU-CHECK: A Standardized Web-Based Architecture for Shift Handover Management. Implements the 4 core capstone modules from Ian Mutuma Kiome's Strathmore University proposal: Unified SBAR & HEI active turnover suite, Embedded 10-item System Usability Scale (SUS) debrief tab, Dynamic user-defined equipment and category engine, and Dual Cryptographic Verification Ledger.
